Georgia
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Consulate General of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Istanbul, Turkiye.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport NO Read explanation
Regular biometric passport NO Read explanation
Service/Official biometric passport NO Read explanation
Diplomatic biometric passport NO Read explanation
EXPLANATION: Citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina do not need a visa to enter and stay in the territory of the Republic of Georgia, except for employees of diplomatic missions, consular offices, representatives of offices of international organizations and other similar representative offices. They still need a visa for their first entry in Georgia for the purpose of work. From 01.01.2026, all tourists entering Georgia are required to have travel health insurance.
Citizens of the Republic of Georgia are exempted from the obligation to obtain a visa for entry, exit, transit and stay on the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina up to ninety (90) days in any period of a hundred and eighty (180) days, which means taking into account the period of a hundred and eighty (180) days preceding each day of a stay.
